searchText: We are cutting a Lodestar release today, would like feedback on which mainnet config params should we include if any - BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH: appears unlikely to chance, would be inclined to include in the release - TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY: better to not include until confirmation next week? sounds reasonable, but may also be easier to just wait until you know for certain sounds messy if you did need to rollback knowing that one version of lodestar would fork users

excerpts.author: dapplion
excerpts.content:
We are cutting a Lodestar release today, would like feedback on which mainnet config params should we include if any
- BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH: appears unlikely to chance, would be inclined to include in the release
- TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY: better to not include until confirmation next week?

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: sounds reasonable, but may also be easier to just wait until you know for certain

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: sounds messy if you did need to rollback knowing that one version of lodestar would fork users
